- Even without blue fire, the sunrise and turquoise crater lake are spectacular.
perbaikan.answerUsulan:

- Access down into the crater floor is currently CLOSED by the authorities, so the natural blue fire cannot be viewed officially at this time. We never promise it.
- NOT guaranteed -- visibility depends on weather, volcanic activity, and local authority clearance.

perbaikan.masalah: 'highest chance of Blue Fire at Ijen' dan 'blue fire less likely' masih menyiratkan Blue Fire bisa dilihat bila musimnya tepat.
perbaikan.answerSekarang:
- Dry season (April-October): best visibility, highest chance of Blue Fire at Ijen.
- Wet season (November-March): possible rain and fog; Bromo can still be beautiful; Ijen hikes still possible but blue fire less likely.
perbaikan.answerUsulan:
- Dry season (April-October): best visibility for the Bromo sunrise and the Ijen crater rim.
- Wet season (November-March): possible rain and fog; Bromo can still be beautiful; Ijen hikes are still possible.
- Blue fire is not part of the plan at the moment: access down into the crater floor is closed by the authorities.
perbaikan.yangBerubah: Rujukan musiman ke Blue Fire dihapus dan diganti keterangan penutupan akses. Panduan musimnya sendiri dipertahankan.
